notes.title: Bug Fixes, QoL changes, & Localisation Updates
notes.notes:
Regular update to fix bugs, improve quality of life, and finally update localisation!

Want to help out with localising MuseSwipr to other languages and get your name in the (soon-to-be-added) credits section of the game? Join our Discord and join the localisation and translation channel!

Quality of Life Improvements

Volume can be changed anywhere by holding ALT and scroll-wheeling (previously this was also the case, but you could also just scroll anywhere and affect the volume which led to accidental volume changes quite often)  
The tutorial is now skippable - though you won't get the tutorial completion achievement. Hold down Esc in the tutorial to skip and exit.
Improved play data tracking!
Bug Fixes

Fixed bug where:

after playing the tutorial, none of the bottom buttons would work  
the song progress bar would sometimes disappear in autoplay mode  
restore to default settings would not restore some settings to their defaults
Localisation Updates

Updated many untranslated texts in MuseSwipr to use localised texts (still a work in progress!)  
Updated German localisation - HUGE thanks to Veii, klave, and shanya for your localisation efforts!!  
Added Indonesian localisation - and another HUGE thanks to handofmyths for your contributions!!!  
Updated Russian localisation - and yet another HUGE thanks to ppiece of cat for providing updated translations!!!!  
Updated missing translations with auto-translated texts. You can tell what text is auto-translated based on whether it has (A) in front of it or not. These are placeholders, and we aim to replace them with human translations in future updates.  
And thanks again to everyone in the past who has ever contributed to localisations for MuseSwipr! We plan on adding a credits section soon in the game and will include everyone who has contributed so far.
If you'd like to help out with localisations (or just hang out with the amazing MuseSwipr community in general), join our Discord!

notes.title: 🎉 Big Changes Coming to MuseSwipr! 🎶
notes.notes:
We’ve got some exciting news to update you all with as we continue making the MuseSwipr experience even better!

🎶 On-going MuseSwipr Editor Updates 🎶

As some of you may know, we've been working on a updated version of the MuseSwipr editor (known as "Editor v2") which is currently separate from the MuseSwipr game itself. We're working hard behind the scenes on Editor v2, which will eventually be built into the game - though, this is a big project.

As part of this ongoing update to MuseSwipr's editor, we want to phase out 'v1' maps by removing Editor v1 (the current in-game editor) in the next update. 
In the mean time, you can still make your own custom maps using Editor v2 which you can grab from our Discord, or the Google Drive link.

If you've got some Editor v1 maps you want to convert to the v2 format, here's what you can do:
1. Open the Timing Point Panel (F6) in your map
2. Hit Ctrl+G to copy your map
3. Paste them into Editor v2 with Ctrl+V

(V1 maps that are on the Steam workshop will continue to work, so no need worry about those!)
If you need any support, feel free to reach out to us on the MuseSwipr Discord!

👀 What's Next? 👀
Updates have been a little bit sparse, but that's because we have been working hard behind the scenes on big updates! We want the community to have something to look forward to though, so here's a sneak peek of some of the big things we're working on:

🎨 UI visual overhaul - giving MuseSwipr a less... 'derivative' look when it comes to the user interface... and adding a ton of features based on feedback!

🏆 Scoring updates, better leaderboards, and... a ranking system??

🎶 And of course, more built-in songs from amazing featured artists!

We’re super excited about what’s coming next, and we couldn’t do it without our amazing community (speaking of, you should totally join our Discord here: https://discord.com/invite/NQ7UvKaU6z)

- Erkfir & Kartsu

notes.title: 🖥️ Enhanced Resolution Options + Full Screen Modes + Bug Fixes 🖥️ - May 3
notes.notes:
🖥️ Full Screen and Resolution Enhancements

 Fixed issue where seesaw mod was not working on different resolutions.
 Changed the "Is Borderless" option to a dropdown for "Full-Screen Mode". Options include Full Screen, Full Screen (Borderless), and Windowed.


 When Full Screen is selected, the resolution dropdown only shows resolutions that match the aspect ratio of the native display (to prevent stretching). This full screen mode is also known as “exclusive full screen”.
 Full Screen (borderless) and Windowed will show all available resolutions up to and including the native resolution.
 Note that Full Screen (borderless and not borderless) does not do any letterboxing to render the game at your native resolution.

 Fixed autoplay breaking with resolution changes
 Fixed seesaw being broken with resolution changes


🛠️ Other Fixes and Improvements

 Fixed deleting Steam map packs resulting in “ghost” song panels
 Fixed skin editor not allowing the skin creator’s name to be changed.
 Increased the size of in-game chat slightly.
 Skin editor now will only accept sprites that have image dimensions of power of 2 (e.g., 256x256, 512x512, …) to reduce the number of issues with texture loading.
 Fixed difficulty sliders displaying the wrong values for newer maps.

 Difficulty calculation has been updated!
[olist]
Difficulty has been split into unranked and ranked and displayed in Song Selection as  (). E.g., 5.06 (4.61) means an unranked difficulty of 5.06 and ranked difficulty of 4.61.
Difficulty calculation will not be skewed as heavily with maps that have very dense single lane streams (ranked and unranked are affected differently).

The following search string format can now be used to filter by difficulty:
(star|stars|diff|difficulty)(=||=|!=)(float number)

Usage examples:
[olist]
 `camellia stars>2 stars9` to search for songs more than 9 stars
 `no speculation` will look for maps with `no` or `speculation` in it while
